## 1. Purpose

This Basis of Design records the pursuit team's preliminary standby power and fuel storage sizing approach for coordination between mechanical, electrical, and site/civil disciplines ahead of Proposal submission.

## 2. Generation Capacity

Standby generation is sized to the Class D estimate in NREOCRC-OPR-001 Section 12.2 (850–1,050 kW), configured N+1 paralleled per the same Section, at the top of the stated range (1,050 kW) to provide design margin.

## 3. Fuel Storage Sizing

Fuel storage capacity is sized to **72 hours of continuous full-load operation at 1,050 kW**, consistent with the City of North River Fuel Storage Bylaw minimum referenced in NREOCRC-OPR-001 Section 12.2, plus the assumed 24-hour contracted bulk refuelling window referenced in the same Section. Preliminary tank sizing and the Fuel Storage room footprint (Functional Program Row 29, 60 m²) were coordinated on this 72-hour basis.

## 4. Flood Protection

Fuel storage and generator equipment are located and protected per NREOCRC-OPR-001 Section 12.3 and Section 4.5 (proximity to mapped regulatory floodplain); flood-protection detailing is not addressed further in this draft.

## 5. Open Items for Next Revision

- Confirm final generator configuration and paralleling switchgear approach.
- Coordinate final tank footprint against Fuel Storage room area (Row 29) once tank vendor selection is advanced.
- **Reconcile this Basis of Design against any RFP Addenda issued after the date of this draft** (see Section header, Basis Date) before this document is finalized for Proposal submission.
